content.text: As of block 20,399,245, this contract calls itself USDC, the name of a well-known digital dollar meant to be worth $1 per token. I haven't confirmed that this is Circle's official USDC, so the name alone doesn't prove it. About 41.6 million tokens exist, the wallet you asked about holds 1,311,134 of them (roughly 3%), and the contract is controlled by a single admin address, 0x9f8e…4d92, whose real-world owner I can't identify from the chain.
